currency summary preserves proportions, exclusions and font size

AccountStatsSummaryTests.Both_surfaces_s.reason: The original single/mixed-currency transaction fixtures run through temporary SQLite, the production API and preload on both native surfaces. They assert 33.3% refunds, 50% bundles, $30/$10 net spend, the complete exclusion note, original 22/40px minima and bounded visible percentages.

tests.case: does not invent percentages or currency totals for unknown prices
does not represent missing product prices as zero spend
all refunded transactions retain a real 100 percent refund share without inventing a bundle denominator

AccountStatsSummaryTests.Missing_prices_.reason: Empty captures, licence-only captures, unknown prices, zero product denominators and overlapping account identities never display invented money or percentages. Both surfaces additionally verify all-refunded purchases have a real 100% refund share, zero net spend, no bundle denominator and no kept-transaction average.

tests.case: switches chart currencies without blending amounts or losing focus on %s
currency charts retain focus, refresh selection, exact composition and readable details
keeps currency on refresh, selects a remaining currency when removed, and has independent surface state

AccountStatsSummaryTests.Currency_charts.reason: The original fake-repository chart payload runs through native main/preload at isolated desktop widths 1200/600 and fullscreen window widths 1920/1280 (140% text at 1280). Exact $16 average, 2023 peak, $1200/€240 composition, exclusively euro year labels, selector focus, controller Right/Accept and refresh retention are verified. Disclosure/reading controls share the chosen currency; geometry excludes horizontal overflow.

AccountStatsSummaryTests.Overlapping_acc.reason: The same known/unknown-account overlap suppresses monetary charts and values while retaining the five recorded retail licences. The shared screen presents an explicit overlap explanation.

AccountStatsSummaryTests.Negative_amount.reason: Signed negative year amounts remain visible, invalid negative composition charts are withheld with an explanation, and a zero recorded year remains in the chart and peak-year insight.
